player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing Guess The Number.
You have to guess the number between {min_number} and {max_number} within {max_turns} turns.
As you enter your guess, the game will provide you with hints such as 'higher' or 'lower'.
You may provide your response in any manner. Only the number that is wrapped in square brackets will be considered as your guess. For example, [5].
As you play, the history of your guesses will be appended below. Use the information to complete the game before you run out of guesses.
Enter your guess.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lisolo lya kufwata lisamunene. Mwana {player_id} akaleka na '[number]' lya kwikala.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muena manaya {player_id} uvua muela meji ne: mbadi bungi budi kabuyi bukumbanyine.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Tshilendu tshidi katshiyi tshimpe. {player_id} mmupatule bungi bua kasumbu ka banayi (nombres).

game_message.target_higher: Badi ne bua kuikala bungi bupite ebu.

outcome.win: Tuasakidila, udi muanji kuela meji bimpe.
outcome.turn_limit: Maloza ya mikwano imefika. Linaloa: {guess}, Lelo: {target}
